What We Do Insights & News Careers About Contact Us city, state, country or zip code job title or keywords Search Job Map Talent Community Previous Applicant Veterans Delivery Manager - Technology Solutions Group (Kansas City) Kansas City, MO Job: Information Technology Primary Location: Kansas City, MO Schedule: Full-time Travel: Yes, 10 % of the Time Req ID: 263722 Description The Delivery Manager in the Technology Solutions Group (TSG) is a critical role responsible for the successful execution and delivery of solutions and digital products. This individual will ensure all assigned projects adhere to the TSG Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Agile processes. The Delivery Manager will serve as the central point of contact for customers throughout the delivery process, working in close collaboration with UX/UI teams, development teams, and business stakeholders to ensure healthy, on-time, and on-budget project completion. Job Duties Delivery Oversight: Manage and oversee the end-to-end delivery of technology solutions, ensuring alignment with the TSG SDLC and Agile methodologies. **Process Alignment: ** Champion and align the execution of the SDLC across all project phases, from initiation to deployment and closure. **Stakeholder Collaboration: ** Work closely with UX/UI designers, development teams, and customers to facilitate clear communication, manage expectations, and ensure project goals are met. **Scope Definition: ** Author and maintain comprehensive scope documents that clearly outline project objectives, deliverables, timelines, and resources. **Status Reporting: ** Define and implement processes for health and status reporting, providing transparent and consistent updates to customers and internal leadership. **Central Point of Contact: ** Act as the primary liaison for the customer throughout the solution delivery lifecycle, addressing questions, resolving issues, and managing project changes. **Project Health: ** Proactively monitor project health to ensure work is delivered on time and within budget, identifying risks and implementing mitigation strategies to maintain healthy delivery. All other duties as assigned. Qualifications Bachelor Degree in Information Technology or Computer Sciences or a related technical field from accredited program. and 14 years related experience in Information Technology. Required In-depth understanding of how to connect technology solutions to business needs and strategy strongly preferred. Proven experience leading project delivery within an established Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) framework strongly preferred. Strong knowledge of and experience with Agile (Scrum, Kanban) and Waterfall methodologies. Strong knowledge of the Atlassian suite (Jira, Confluence) strongly preferred. Demonstrated ability to write clear and concise scope documents and technical project documentation strongly preferred. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to act as a primary point of contact for customers and technical teams strongly preferred. Experience in a client-facing role, with a strong focus on customer satisfaction and relationship management strongly preferred. Proven ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including UX/UI designers and software developers strongly preferred. Strong organizational skills with experience in defining and managing project status and health reporting strongly preferred. This job posting will remain open a minimum of 72 hours and on an ongoing basis until filled. EEO/Disabled/Veterans Apply Now Not Ready to Apply? Apply Now Not Ready to Apply?
